title: Wavetoo's "Underneath the Lemon Tree" is a powerful display
htmlContent:
Wavetoo's "Underneath the Lemon Tree" is a powerful display that you don’t want to miss out on. He displays excellence from beginning to end with masterful focus. From the sharp lyrics that shows how incredible his pen is, the exhilarating flow that brings excitement, and it’s all over a beat that sounds made for him to snap on.

The flow is relentless and brutal enough to deliver the raw lyrics with the ultimate conviction that sells the high-class level of emceeing to perfection.
